Name: Zernio
Tagline: Marketing infrastructure for products and agents
Description: Zernio is the marketing infrastructure 200,000 developers build products on. We absorb the integrations, platform approvals and maintenance behind every channel, all on official APIs, so you can start building today. One API covers 16 social platforms, ads on 7 networks, WhatsApp, iMessage, and phone numbers with calls and SMS that you buy inside Zernio. Use the REST API in your code, or let your coding agent do the same through our MCP server and CLI.

Name: Busabase
Tagline: The general system of record for AI agents
Description: Different agents. One shared base. Busabase is a general-purpose database and workspace for people and AI agents. Keep business records, docs, skills, and apps in one place so the next task can build on them. Connect Claude Code, Codex, and more. Set access, review changes when needed, and see what changed. Busabase is open source, with Cloud, Personal Desktop, and self-hosting options.

Name: Together Link
Tagline: Use open models in your harness
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Together Link connects coding agents to open models on Together AI, letting developers keep their existing tools and workflows while reducing model costs.

Name: Gemini Agent for Google Cloud
Tagline: The work agent that runs on both Gemini and Claude
Description: Gemini agent is Google Cloud's single, universal agent for work. Give it an objective, not instructions: it plans, uses your company's skills and tools, connects to Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Salesforce, Jira or any MCP server, and hands back finished docs, decks or code. Unlike chat assistants that stop at an answer, it keeps running in the cloud for hours or days, spins up coworker agents with their own email and calendar, and routes each job to the right model under hard spend caps.

Name: Odyssey 3
Tagline: A world model that simulates physics in real time
Description: Odyssey-3 is a foundation world model that generates interactive environments from a prompt and predicts in real time how they change as you or an agent act in them. Its Pro version posts the highest reported Physics-IQ Verified video-to-video score (66.1, best-of-8). The same model has been adapted to control robot arms and humanoids, drive a car, and train agents. Try the research preview, or get in touch for API access.x`

Name: Staffcoder
Tagline: Build like a real engineer
Description: Staffcoder is a hands-on coding platform where developers practice real engineering work instead of algorithm puzzles. Choose from 1000+ challenges across 39 learning paths, covering React, Next.js, Django, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, AI agents, and more. Every challenge runs in a full browser IDE with a real terminal, file system, and live preview, so there is nothing to install. Pick a stack, open a challenge, and build. Free to start.

Name: Pine Computer
Tagline: A cloud computer built for AI to get jobs done
Description: Pine Computer is a cloud computer built for AI to use. Your product hands it a job: research, forms, spreadsheets, portals with no API. The finished work comes back. AI reads each app's structure instead of pixels, is told when something changes, and gets as many virtual screens as it needs. Spin up a computer per customer through one SDK, bring your own model or use ours, and let a person take over for sign-ins or approvals. Invite-only beta.

Name: Opposable
Tagline: Computer use for phones to give your AI thumbs
Description: Opposable lets Claude Code, Codex or any MCP agent see, tap and type on a real iPhone or Android phone, in every app you're signed into. Common tasks run on the phone with no model at all, payments wait for your tap, and iPhones work through Bluetooth or a tiny USB stick.

Name: BrightBean Studio
Tagline: Open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams
Description: BrightBean Studio is a free, open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams, agencies and small businesses. Schedule and publish to 10+ platforms, manage approvals, analytics and inboxes, and connect AI agents through the built-in MCP server and REST API.

Name: OpenPilot
Tagline: Open-source desktop AI agent for any model you choose
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: OpenPilot is a free, MIT-licensed desktop AI agent. Connect any OpenAI-compatible model (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio), pick a folder, and it reads and edits files and runs commands there. You approve sensitive actions. Windows now, macOS early beta.

Name: Amazon Alexa Tablets
Tagline: Full Google Play, Alexa+ and a Kindle reading mode
Description: Amazon Alexa Tablets are a new Android lineup with full Google Play access and Alexa+ built in. Available in 8.7-inch, 11-inch, and 12-inch sizes, they bring on-screen AI assistance, live conversations, a distraction-free Kindle reading mode, and an optional Nanomatte display on the 12 Pro.

Name: OpenCharm
Tagline: Open-source body for the AI agent you already run
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: OpenCharm is an open-source body for the AI agent you already run, right by your Mac's notch. Hold one key to talk and Claude Code, Codex or any agent gets to work, answers out loud and asks when it needs you. Next, it hangs from your keychain.

Name: iwant
Tagline: Find available GPUs and host open models in one command
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Host your own DeepSeek, Kimi, Minimax, MiMo, Step with with one command. iwant hunts across GCP regions for available GPUs, then handles provisioning, model downloads, and vLLM setup. One command gives you an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, an API key, and SSH access.

Name: Playground by Google Labs
Tagline: Create, play, and share your own games with Google AI
Description: Google Playground is an experimental AI gaming platform that lets anyone create, play, and share custom games without coding. Describe your idea, choose a genre, and let AI build a playable game in minutes. Change the rules, characters, physics, or visuals simply by chatting. Share your creation with friends, publish it to the community gallery, or explore games made by others. Powered by Google's Gemini, Nano Banana, and Lyria models.

Name: OpenVids
Tagline: Open-source video editor you run by chatting with AI agents
Description: Open-source, agent-first AI video editor for macOS and Windows. Describe the film — agents cut the timeline, add motion and sound, and review the render.

Name: Melete
Tagline: An Always On Personal Agent With a Team Workspace
Description: Meet Melete, Your Personal Agent, on your hardware. The more you use AI, the more you have to teach it. Every new chat means explaining the project again. Melete is a personal AI agent with its own computer. It remembers what you're working on, keeps unfinished jobs moving while you're away, and picks a project back up weeks later without starting over. Melete Cloud is open for waitlist signups. For companies, we're taking a small number of pilot teams.

Name: Refs
Tagline: Give Claude better references for your launch film
Topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Photo & Video
Description: Refs is a library of 3000+ films that moved people, each measured cut by cut and written up as a 15-plate blueprint with a recipe prompt. Add it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with one command, and Claude plans your launch film from the real thing.

Name: HeyPi
Tagline: Build and ship anything live, in-meetings
Description: Most AI meeting tools capture what happened and send you notes. HeyPi follows the conversation in real time, remembers what was said across current and past meetings, privately surfaces key information when useful, and starts handling follow-up work across your tools before the meeting ends. Pi can also bring your boldest product and marketing ideas to life — landing pages, apps, social media content, ad campaigns and more live in the meeting. Less AI notes. More AI execution.

Name: Murmur
Tagline: A private voice-first notepad for your thoughts
Topics: Android, Social Network, Social Media, Audio
Description: Murmur is a private, voice-first memory for your thoughts. Speak instead of typing, and Murmur turns your fleeting thoughts into searchable memories. Later, ask what you were thinking about, rediscover forgotten ideas, or send a thought to your future self with Future Capsules. No feeds. No followers. Just your thoughts, remembered.

Name: Voicera
Tagline: Turn natural speech into polished text, perfected with AI
Description: Voicera turns your natural speech into clean, polished writing, then lets you rewrite, fix, translate, and improve it with AI, right where you type.
